status_summary: No qualifying action was found: no source reports an increase in OIRA funding or staffing, or the creation of early-engagement regulatory advance teams, since 2025-01-20. An opinion commentary of 2026-01-29 says no OIRA Administrator had been nominated, which points away from expansion, though it gives no staffing or funding figures.
title: Raise OIRA funding and staff regulatory advance teams, separate from reviewers
uncertainties: Checked systematically on 2026-10-18. (1) Federal Register API: the researcher's query on regulatory advance teams returned no documents since 2025-01-20, and a reviewer rerun on the Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs with staffing returned 675 loosely matched documents whose most recent page held only unrelated rulemakings that name OIRA as a comment destination; no document on OIRA funding, staffing or advance teams was seen, though only the first page of results was examined. (2) Unified Agenda: the reginfo.gov landing page was reached but agenda items could not be listed, so only the Federal Register fallback was used; an internal staffing matter would not normally appear there in any case. (3) congress.gov and govinfo: one search surfaced a CRS overview of OIRA and FY2026 appropriations bills, with no bill on OIRA advance teams or a dedicated OIRA funding increase; appropriation line amounts for OMB and the OMB budget justifications for FY2026 and FY2027 were not examined. (4) Agency pages: the OIRA page on whitehouse.gov did not load, so no agency statement was seen. (5) News: one search returned only older think-tank and CRS pieces. OIRA staffing levels therefore remain unknown and the not_started finding rests on absence in these checks.
